scandal.title: The fake medical report
scandal.summary: In the 2024 São Paulo mayoral race, Pablo Marçal posted a medical report claiming his rival Guilherme Boulos had used cocaine. Forensic and Federal Police exams found the document was fake — the doctor who supposedly signed it had already died. The Federal Police recommended charges against Marçal for forging a document and electoral slander. In 2026 he worked as a strategist for Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign.
scandal.status: Ordered in February 2026 to pay Boulos R$ 100,000, subject to appeal; barred from running for office until 2032 by a ruling upheld on appeal; the police recommendation has not become a criminal conviction.

scandal.title: The campaign in the US
scandal.summary: Eduardo Bolsonaro moved to the United States in February 2025 and lobbied the Trump administration for sanctions against Brazilian officials — according to Brazil's Prosecutor-General, to pressure his father's trial at the Supreme Court. He lost his seat in Congress in December 2025 for missing too many sessions.
scandal.status: Convicted by the Supreme Court's First Panel in June 2026 and sentenced to 4 years and 2 months for coercion in the course of proceedings, a final ruling; in October 2026 Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the sentence served, issued an arrest warrant and cancelled his passports.

scandal.title: The parallel intelligence agency
scandal.summary: In 2025 the Federal Police concluded that Brazil's intelligence agency (Abin) had allegedly been used, under Jair Bolsonaro, to spy on opponents, and pointed to Rio city councilman Carlos Bolsonaro as head of the so-called "hate office", which would use that information for attacks online. He was recommended for charges along with more than 30 people and says the move was politically motivated.
scandal.status: Recommended for charges by the Federal Police in June 2025; in July 2026 the Supreme Court sent his part of the case to a federal appeals court (TRF-1); no charges and no conviction.

scandal.title: The Federal Police document
scandal.summary: Congressman Nikolas Ferreira shared a fake document attributed to the Federal Police, a case that became an electoral lawsuit at the Minas Gerais electoral court (TRE-MG). Brazil's Prosecutor-General also took to the Supreme Court a defamation charge over a remark in which he called President Lula a thief; his defense invokes parliamentary immunity.
scandal.status: Defamation charge under review at the Supreme Court; the TRE-MG case could cost him his seat but has not been ruled on; no conviction.

scandal.title: The loan
scandal.summary: In 2024 the Federal District civil police charged Jair Renan Bolsonaro, now a city councilman in Balneário Camboriú, with allegedly using false data about his own company to get a loan of nearly R$ 500,000. The forgery charges were dropped after the loan was paid off.
scandal.status: In February 2026 the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) halted the last charge, for money laundering; there is no ongoing case. His defense calls it an acquittal, which the ruling does not say.

scandal.title: The former Alerj aide
scandal.summary: Fabrício Queiroz was Flávio Bolsonaro's aide at the Rio state assembly (Alerj), and Rio state prosecutors (MP-RJ) named him as the operator of the salary kickback scheme. He was arrested in 2020 at a property owned by the family's lawyer in Atibaia. In September 2026, a ruling by Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes cited signs that his account gathered transfers from the office's staffers.
scandal.status: Case dismissed in 2022 after evidence was annulled; in September 2026 the MP-RJ was asked to reopen it. Queiroz campaigned for Flávio in 2026.

scandal.title: The movie's banker
scandal.summary: Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, was arrested by the Federal Police in November 2025 while trying to leave the country, in what is described as Brazil's biggest banking fraud. According to the Federal Police, he promised up to R$ 131 million for the movie "Dark Horse", about Jair Bolsonaro, and about R$ 60 million was allegedly transferred through a fund in the US.
scandal.status: The Banco Master investigations continue; no conviction. He denies the accusations and says they are based on "a nonexistent fact".
